name: Mexican Revolution
short_desc: Revolutionary factions overthrow the old regime and fight over Mexico’s government, land and social order.
date_note: The conventional 1910–1920 frame covers the main armed revolutionary phase. Regional violence and revolutionary reforms continued beyond it.
notes: Added after a catalog gap review on 24 October 2026. A major Latin American social revolution absent from a catalog rich in European revolutions and civil wars. Evidence and date rationale: The conventional 1910–1920 frame runs from the uprising against Porfirio Díaz to the rise of Álvaro Obregón. It is not a claim that every locality became peaceful in 1920 or that later revolutionary reforms ended then. Primary evidence: https://guides.loc.gov/chronicling-america-mexican-revolution. Cached Wikipedia introduction and lead image provide separately attributed background. Remains review, not comprehensive factual approval.
